title: Partial STS Array
description: Partial STSs. One STS for each Pickles scenario.

variableDefinition.title: Variable Definition
variableDefinition.description: Type and domain of a variable, an array element or a structure attribute. Arrays and structures can nest to any depth.

type.description: Data type. An 'array' or a 'structure' is one entry. The translator does not expand it into slots or attributes.

range.description: Allowed values of a scalar variable, in order. The JSON type must agree with 'type'.

unique.description: Only for arrays. If true, all elements must be different. The translator adds a 'uniqueElem' guard to each switch that uses the variable.

elements.description: Only for arrays. Definition of each element: a primitive, an array or a structure.

attributes.description: Only for structures. One definition for each attribute, keyed by attribute ID.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: An input or output gate. It has a label and a list of parameters.

text.description: Label from the Pickles 'When' (input) or 'Then' (output) step.

parameters.description: Parameter IDs of the gate, in order. Each ID is a key in the STS 'parameters' map. Can be empty.

guardExpr.title: Guard Expression
guardExpr.description: An expression node: a variable reference, a literal or an operator node.

oneOf.title: Variable Reference
oneOf.description: Reference to a variable, a parameter or a quantifier 'element' (e.g. 'x'). For a structure attribute, use 'project'.
Set literal. It is the rhs of 'in' or 'not in' when the spec gives the values inline. A named constant array uses a Variable Reference.

oneOf.title: Binary operator node
oneOf.description: A node with two operands. 'elem' is true if 'lhs' is in the array 'rhs'. 'project' gets attribute 'rhs' of structure 'lhs'. Chain 'project' nodes for nested attributes.

oneOf.title: Unary operator node
oneOf.description: A node with one operand, 'rhs'. '!' negates a boolean expression. 'not' negates a membership check. 'len' gives the length of an array. 'uniqueElem' is true if all array elements are different.

oneOf.title: Count guard node
oneOf.description: True if the number of elements in 'over' that satisfy 'expression' is 'quantifier' 'n'. From 'X has at least/at most/exactly N elements where each element ...'. For 'at least 1', see 'exists'.

n.description: The number of elements to compare.

over.description: The array to check. A Variable Reference, or a 'project' chain for a structure attribute.

lambda.description: Name of the current element (e.g. 'x'). Use it in 'expression' as {"var": "x"}. A nested quantifier uses a different name.

expression.description: The condition for each element. Refer to the element by its 'element' name. Use 'project' to get its attributes.

oneOf.title: Exists guard node
oneOf.description: True if one or more elements in 'over' satisfy 'expression'. From 'X has at least 1 element where each element ...'.

over.description: The array to check. Same as in 'count'.

lambda.description: Name of the current element. Same as in 'count'.

expression.description: The condition for each element. Same as in 'count'.

oneOf.title: Forall guard node
oneOf.description: True if all elements in 'over' satisfy 'expression'. From 'X has all elements where each element ...'. The translator also adds it to keep array elements in range.

over.description: The array to check. Same as in 'count'.

lambda.description: Name of the current element. Same as in 'count'.

expression.description: The condition for each element. Same as in 'count'.

initialScalar.title: Initial Scalar Value
initialScalar.description: A plain JSON literal for an initial value.

initialValue.title: Initial Value
initialValue.description: Initial value of a variable. A scalar for a primitive, or an array of scalars for an array.

assignment.title: Assignment
assignment.description: One variable update. It occurs when the switch is executed.

target.description: Target variable ID. It is a key in the STS 'locationVariables' map.

expression.description: Right-hand side. Usually a parameter reference (e.g. {"var": "water-level_p"}).

switch.title: Switch
switch.description: A transition between two locations. It is executed when its gate occurs and all its guards hold. Then its assignments occur.

init_loc.description: Source location ID. It is in the STS 'locations' array.

gate.description: Gate ID. It is a key in 'inputGates' or 'outputGates'.

guard.description: Guard IDs from the STS 'guards' map. All guards must hold. The translator adds range guards for each variable that the switch uses, and a 'len' guard for array length.

assignments.description: Assignment IDs from the STS 'assignments' map, in order. Can be empty.

end_loc.description: Target location ID. It is in the STS 'locations' array.

sts.title: STS
sts.description: One STS from one Pickles scenario.

description.description: Scenario label, usually with the scenario number first.

documentation.description: Text from the optional 'Documentation:' section. Empty if not present. Newlines become spaces.

initial_state.description: True if the Given step has an INITCOND predicate. Then the scenario sets the initial state of the system.

initial_location.description: Start location: 'L0_<N>'. N is the number in 'id' (e.g. 'L0_1').

initialValuation.description: Initial value of each location variable, keyed by variable ID. A variable with no initial value has no key. A constant always has a key.

locationVariables.description: All location variables, keyed by variable ID. Each variable is one entry, also arrays and structures.

parameters.description: Gate parameters. One for each location variable, keyed by variable ID + '_p'. Same type and range as the variable.

inputGates.description: Input gates from 'When' steps, keyed by gate ID. The same text and parameters give the same ID in all STSs of the file.

outputGates.description: Output gates from 'Then' steps, keyed by gate ID. IDs are shared between STSs, as in 'inputGates'.

guards.description: Guards keyed by ID ('G1_STS001', 'G2_STS001', ...). They come from Given, When and Then steps. They are unique between STSs.

assignments.description: Assignments keyed by ID ('A1_STS001', 'A2_STS001', ...). They are unique between STSs.

switches.description: Switches keyed by ID ('r_1', 'r_2', ...). One for each When step and each Then step, in scenario order.
